_about: What is said in the Gennoor AI Weekend film. One entry is one breath of narration. `pad` is the silence after it, in seconds. No dates and no price: both change, and the page carries them.

lines.text: What could you build with AI in one weekend?
Come and see. Two live sessions. One Saturday, one Sunday.
On day one, we start with how AI works, and set it up to know your work. Then a weekly report, in minutes.
After that, pictures, video and sound, made with AI. And skills and connectors, so it can reach your files and your tools.
On day two, we automate a task you repeat every week. Then we build your first agent.
Give it a goal, and it researches, drafts, and checks its own work. And last, a team of agents, working together.
Everything is built live, step by step. Then you get the complete kit, so you can repeat it yourself.
The AI Weekend. Live, online, the last weekend of every month.
Reserve your seat. The link is on the screen.
